fields.Name: T121 - AI MCP Dashboard
fields.Description: Verifies the MCP section of the AI app renders its dashboard with a server list/tool catalog or a valid empty-state.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the MCP section. Confirm the MCP dashboard renders, showing a server list or tool catalog or a valid empty-state. This is a platform view that may have sparse data in a fresh regression DB, so accept an empty-state as long as the dashboard chrome renders. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for content rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The AI app MCP section is displayed
The view shows an MCP dashboard (server list or tool catalog) or a clear empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
